title: Yummy Chinese Char-Grill Pork Gyoza
description: Crispy, cultured and cozy Chinese-inspired dish from Chaozhou cuisine, featuring a sweet and sour flavor profile.
instructions: Combine ground pork, onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl, mixing well.
Lay out wonton wrappers on a clean surface.
Place 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each wonton wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wonton wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the gyoza to the skillet, leaving space between each dumpling.
Cook the gyoza for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the gyoza from the skillet and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain any excess oil.
Serve the gyoza hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
